description: This file defines the EditorActionBar component and related subcomponents for the Notesnook project, providing UI controls for editing sessions, tab management, and window controls within the web-based note editor.

methods.name: EditorActionBar
methods.description: Main React component rendering the editor's action bar with buttons for tabs, undo/redo, publish, search, properties, and window controls.

methods.name: TabStrip
methods.description: Subcomponent rendering the tab list with drag-and-drop reordering and context menu actions.

methods.name: Tab
methods.description: Component representing an individual tab with context menu and drag-and-drop support.

methods.name: ReorderableList
methods.description: Generic component enabling drag-and-drop reordering of list items using @dnd-kit.
